references.text: Rahab gave the spies instructions to hide in the hills for three days, which they now follow in verse 22.
Moses fled and hid, just as the spies hid in the hills to avoid their pursuers.
David hid in the fields for three days while Jonathan investigated Saul's intentions, similar to the spies' three days in hiding.
David hid in the hills, and Saul searched for him every day but did not find him, parallel to the pursuers who looked for the spies but did not find them.
The psalm speaks of God as a refuge from the enemy, thematically linked to the spies' flight and hiding.
Proverbs speaks of the wicked who seek but do not find, similar to the pursuers who searched along the entire road but did not find the spies.
